tagline: A leafy, up-and-coming residential area between Şişli and Beşiktaş — creative businesses, independent cafés, and a local scene that hasn't been discovered yet.

items.name: Fulya Sokak Cafés
items.description: Several independent specialty coffee shops have opened on Fulya's quieter streets. A growing specialty coffee scene away from the tourist zones.

items.name: Fulya ve Kuştepe Restoranları
items.description: A mix of Turkish and international restaurants catering to the local professional and creative crowd. Good quality at reasonable prices.

items.name: Bomonti ve Fulya Arası Yürüyüş
items.description: The streets between Fulya and Bomonti are worth exploring on foot — emerging creative studios, small galleries, and the best neighbourhood walking in the area.

tips: Fulya is between Şişli and Beşiktaş metro stops — walkable from both.
One of Istanbul's quieter residential areas that is rapidly attracting creative businesses.
Best explored on foot — the streets don't lend themselves to a specific route.
Good value compared to Cihangir or Nişantaşı for the same neighbourhood feel.
